name: Tools and toolbox parts
meta_title: Toolbox Latches and Tool Parts, 3D Printed | PartRevive
meta_description: 3D-printed latches, hinges and clips for toolboxes, coolers, hard cases and outdoor power tools, in PETG or carbon-fiber nylon. Quote in 24 hours.
intro: Toolbox, cooler and hard-case latches take drops, cold and the weight of stacked boxes, and a broken latch can sideline good gear. We print replacement latches, hinges and clips in PETG, flexible TPU, or carbon-fiber nylon (PA-CF) for rough use, with the print oriented to the load.
